data.desc: Eton is an innovative pharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing treatments for rare diseases. The Company currently has eleven commercial rare disease products: KHINDIVI (hydrocortisone), INCRELEX (mecasermin), ALKINDI SPRINKLE (hydrocortisone), DESMODA (desmopressin acetate), GALZIN (zinc acetate), HEMANGEOL (propranolol hydrochloride), PKU GOLIKE, IMPAVIDO (miltefosine), Carglumic Acid, Betaine Anhydrous, and Nitisinone. The Company has five additional product candidates in late-stage development: AMGLIDIA (glyburide), ASN- 001, ET - 700, ET -800, and ZENEO hydrocortisone autoinjector.
